scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm run dev --workspace backend" "npm run dev --workspace frontend"
scripts.build: node --check project-paths.js && npm run build --workspace backend && npm run build --workspace frontend && npm run sync:frontend-dist
scripts.lint: node --check project-paths.js && npm run lint --workspace backend && npm run lint --workspace frontend
scripts.clean: npm run clean --workspace backend && npm run clean --workspace frontend
